    <h1 class="devsite-page-title" tabindex="-1">
      Caching<devsite-actions hidden data-nosnippet>
    <devsite-llm-tools></devsite-llm-tools></devsite-actions>
  
      
    </h1>
  <div class="devsite-page-title-meta"><devsite-view-release-notes></devsite-view-release-notes></div>
  

  <devsite-toc class="devsite-nav"
    depth="2"
    devsite-toc-embedded
    >
  </devsite-toc>
  
    
  <div class="devsite-article-body clearfix
  ">

  
    
    <p>Context caching allows you to save and reuse precomputed input tokens that you wish to use repeatedly, for example when asking different questions about the same media file. This can lead to cost and speed savings, depending on the usage. For a detailed introduction, see the <a href="https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/caching">Context caching</a> guide.</p>
<div itemscope="" itemtype="http://developers.google.com/ReferenceObject"><h2 id="method:-cachedcontents.create" data-text="Method: cachedContents.create" tabindex="-1">Method: cachedContents.create</h2><a name="v1beta.cachedContents.create"></a>
<meta content="create" itemprop="name"/>
<meta content="/api/rest/v1beta/cachedContents/create" itemprop="path"/>
<section class="prototype" id="/api/rest/v1beta/cachedContents/create">
<ul class="toc">
<li><a href="#body.HTTP_TEMPLATE">Endpoint</a></li><li><a href="#body.request_body">Request body</a></li><li><a href="#body.response_body">Response body</a></li><li><a href="#body.aspect">Authorization scopes</a></li><li><a href="#body.codeSnippets">Example request</a>
<ul>
<li><a href="#body.codeSnippets.group">Basic</a></li><li><a href="#body.codeSnippets.group_1">From name</a></li><li><a href="#body.codeSnippets.group_2">From chat</a></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<section id="google.ai.generativelanguage.v1beta.CacheService.CreateCachedContent">
</section>
<section id="description">
<p>Creates CachedContent resource.</p>
</section>
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<section id="body.HTTP_TEMPLATE">
<h3 id="endpoint" data-text="Endpoint" tabindex="-1">Endpoint</h3>
<span class="endpoint">
<span class="http-method">
                post
              </span>
<span class="endpoint-url">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">https:<wbr/>/<wbr/>/generativelanguage.googleapis.com<wbr/>/v1beta<wbr/>/cachedContents</code>
</span>
</span>
<br/>
<span>

</span>
</section>
<section id="body.request_body">
<h3 id="request-body" data-text="Request body" tabindex="-1">Request body</h3>
<p>The request body contains an instance of <code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/caching#CachedContent">CachedContent</a></code>.</p>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS">
<thead>
<tr>
<th colspan="2">Fields</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.contents">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">contents[]</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/generate-content#v1beta.Content">Content</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Input only. Immutable. The content to cache.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.tools">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">tools[]</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/generate-content#v1beta.Tool">Tool</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Input only. Immutable. A list of <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Tools</code> the model may use to generate the next response</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<div class="field-entry union-type">
<div class="signature">
<tr class="alt" id="CachedContent.FIELDS.expiration">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">expiration</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">Union type</code>
</span>
</tr>
<div class="union-type-preamble">
<div>Specifies when this resource will expire. The following is a list of mutually exclusive fields. At most one of the fields will be set in a response:</div>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.expire_time">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">expireTime</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#timestamp">Timestamp</a></code> format)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Timestamp in UTC of when this resource is considered expired. This is <em>always</em> provided on output, regardless of what was sent on input.</p><p>Uses RFC 3339, where generated output will always be Z-normalized and use 0, 3, 6 or 9 fractional digits. Offsets other than "Z" are also accepted. Examples: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23Z"</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z"</code> or <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23+05:30"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.ttl">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">ttl</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#duration">Duration</a></code> format)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Input only. New TTL for this resource, input only.</p><p>A duration in seconds with up to nine fractional digits, ending with '<code translate="no" dir="ltr">s</code>'. Example: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"3.5s"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<div>End of mutually exclusive fields.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.display_name">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">displayName</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Immutable. The user-generated meaningful display name of the cached content. Maximum 128 Unicode characters.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.model">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">model</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Required. Immutable. The name of the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Model</code> to use for cached content Format: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">models/{model}</code></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.system_instruction">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">systemInstruction</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/generate-content#v1beta.Content">Content</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Input only. Immutable. Developer set system instruction. Currently text only.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.tool_config">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">toolConfig</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/caching#ToolConfig">ToolConfig</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Input only. Immutable. Tool config. This config is shared for all tools.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section></section>
</div>
<div class="second-column">

<span class="devsite-syntax-n">model_name</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-o">=</span> <span class="devsite-syntax-s2">"gemini-3.7-flash"</span>

</section>
<section id="description">
<p>Lists CachedContents.</p>
</section>
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<section id="body.HTTP_TEMPLATE">
<h3 id="endpoint_1" data-text="Endpoint" tabindex="-1">Endpoint</h3>

<span class="http-method">
                get
              </span>
<span class="endpoint-url">

<section id="body.QUERY_PARAMETERS">
<h3 id="query-parameters" data-text="Query parameters" tabindex="-1">Query parameters</h3>
<section id="body.QUERY_PARAMETERS.page_size">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">pageSize</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">integer</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. The maximum number of cached contents to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified, some default (under maximum) number of items will be returned. The maximum value is 1000; values above 1000 will be coerced to 1000.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="body.QUERY_PARAMETERS.page_token">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">pageToken</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. A page token, received from a previous <code translate="no" dir="ltr">cachedContents.list</code> call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page.</p><p>When paginating, all other parameters provided to <code translate="no" dir="ltr">cachedContents.list</code> must match the call that provided the page token.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>

<section id="google.ai.generativelanguage.v1beta.CacheService.UpdateCachedContent">

</section>

<section id="body.PATH_PARAMETERS">
<h3 id="path-parameters_1" data-text="Path parameters" tabindex="-1">Path parameters</h3>
<section id="body.name">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">cachedContent.name</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. Identifier. The resource name referring to the cached content. Format: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">cachedContents/{id}</code> It takes the form <code translate="no" dir="ltr">cachedContents/{cachedcontent}</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="body.QUERY_PARAMETERS">
<h3 id="query-parameters_1" data-text="Query parameters" tabindex="-1">Query parameters</h3>
<section id="body.QUERY_PARAMETERS.update_mask">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">updateMask</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#field-mask">FieldMask</a></code> format)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The list of fields to update.</p><p>This is a comma-separated list of fully qualified names of fields. Example: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"user.displayName,photo"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="body.request_body">
<h3 id="request-body_3" data-text="Request body" tabindex="-1">Request body</h3>
<p>The request body contains an instance of <code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/caching#CachedContent">CachedContent</a></code>.</p>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS">
<thead>
<tr>
<th colspan="2">Fields</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<div class="field-entry union-type">
<div class="signature">
<tr class="alt" id="CachedContent.FIELDS.expiration">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">expiration</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">Union type</code>
</span>
</tr>
<div class="union-type-preamble">
<div>Specifies when this resource will expire. The following is a list of mutually exclusive fields. At most one of the fields will be set in a response:</div>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.expire_time">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">expireTime</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#timestamp">Timestamp</a></code> format)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Timestamp in UTC of when this resource is considered expired. This is <em>always</em> provided on output, regardless of what was sent on input.</p><p>Uses RFC 3339, where generated output will always be Z-normalized and use 0, 3, 6 or 9 fractional digits. Offsets other than "Z" are also accepted. Examples: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23Z"</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z"</code> or <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23+05:30"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.ttl">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">ttl</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#duration">Duration</a></code> format)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Input only. New TTL for this resource, input only.</p><p>A duration in seconds with up to nine fractional digits, ending with '<code translate="no" dir="ltr">s</code>'. Example: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"3.5s"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<div>End of mutually exclusive fields.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section></section>

<section class="prototype" id="CachedContent">
<h2 id="CachedContent" data-text="Resource: CachedContent" tabindex="-1">Resource: CachedContent</h2>
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<section id="CachedContent.description">
<p>Content that has been preprocessed and can be used in subsequent request to GenerativeService.</p><p>Cached content can be only used with model it was created for.</p>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS">
<thead>
<tr>
<th colspan="2">Fields</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.contents">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">contents[]</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/generate-content#v1beta.Content">Content</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Input only. Immutable. The content to cache.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.tools">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">tools[]</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/generate-content#v1beta.Tool">Tool</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Input only. Immutable. A list of <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Tools</code> the model may use to generate the next response</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.create_time">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">createTime</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#timestamp">Timestamp</a></code> format)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. Creation time of the cache entry.</p><p>Uses RFC 3339, where generated output will always be Z-normalized and use 0, 3, 6 or 9 fractional digits. Offsets other than "Z" are also accepted. Examples: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23Z"</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z"</code> or <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23+05:30"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.update_time">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">updateTime</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#timestamp">Timestamp</a></code> format)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. When the cache entry was last updated in UTC time.</p><p>Uses RFC 3339, where generated output will always be Z-normalized and use 0, 3, 6 or 9 fractional digits. Offsets other than "Z" are also accepted. Examples: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23Z"</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z"</code> or <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23+05:30"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.usage_metadata">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">usageMetadata</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/caching#UsageMetadata">UsageMetadata</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. Metadata on the usage of the cached content.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<div class="field-entry union-type">
<div class="signature">
<tr class="alt" id="CachedContent.FIELDS.expiration">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">expiration</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">Union type</code>
</span>
</tr>
<div class="union-type-preamble">
<div>Specifies when this resource will expire. The following is a list of mutually exclusive fields. At most one of the fields will be set in a response:</div>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.expire_time">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">expireTime</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#timestamp">Timestamp</a></code> format)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Timestamp in UTC of when this resource is considered expired. This is <em>always</em> provided on output, regardless of what was sent on input.</p><p>Uses RFC 3339, where generated output will always be Z-normalized and use 0, 3, 6 or 9 fractional digits. Offsets other than "Z" are also accepted. Examples: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23Z"</code>, <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23.045123456Z"</code> or <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"2014-10-02T15:01:23+05:30"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.ttl">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">ttl</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="https://protobuf.dev/reference/protobuf/google.protobuf/#duration">Duration</a></code> format)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Input only. New TTL for this resource, input only.</p><p>A duration in seconds with up to nine fractional digits, ending with '<code translate="no" dir="ltr">s</code>'. Example: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">"3.5s"</code>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<div>End of mutually exclusive fields.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.name">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">name</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Output only. Identifier. The resource name referring to the cached content. Format: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">cachedContents/{id}</code></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.display_name">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">displayName</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Immutable. The user-generated meaningful display name of the cached content. Maximum 128 Unicode characters.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.model">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">model</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Required. Immutable. The name of the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Model</code> to use for cached content Format: <code translate="no" dir="ltr">models/{model}</code></p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.system_instruction">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">systemInstruction</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/generate-content#v1beta.Content">Content</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Input only. Immutable. Developer set system instruction. Currently text only.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="CachedContent.FIELDS.tool_config">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">toolConfig</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/caching#ToolConfig">ToolConfig</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Input only. Immutable. Tool config. This config is shared for all tools.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</div>

<section class="prototype" id="ToolConfig">
<h2 id="ToolConfig" data-text="ToolConfig" tabindex="-1">ToolConfig</h2>
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<section id="ToolConfig.description">
<p>The Tool configuration containing parameters for specifying <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Tool</code> use in the request.</p>
</section>
<section id="ToolConfig.FIELDS">
<thead>
<tr>
<th colspan="2">Fields</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<section id="ToolConfig.FIELDS.function_calling_config">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">functionCallingConfig</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/caching#FunctionCallingConfig">FunctionCallingConfig</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Function calling config.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="ToolConfig.FIELDS.retrieval_config">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">retrievalConfig</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/caching#RetrievalConfig">RetrievalConfig</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Retrieval config.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="ToolConfig.FIELDS.include_server_side_tool_invocations">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">includeServerSideToolInvocations</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">boolean</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. If true, the API response will include the server-side tool calls and responses within the <code translate="no" dir="ltr">Content</code> message. This allows clients to observe the server's tool interactions.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<div class="second-column">
<section id="ToolConfig.SCHEMA_REPRESENTATION">
<table class="properties responsive fixed">
<thead>
<tr>
<th>JSON representation</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="margin:0;padding:0;"><div></div><devsite-code><pre style="border: 0;margin: 0;" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><span class="pun">{</span>
  <span class="str">"functionCallingConfig"</span><span class="pun">: </span><span class="pun">{</span>
    <span class="kwd">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/caching#FunctionCallingConfig">FunctionCallingConfig</a></code>)</span>
  <span class="pun">}</span><span class="pun">,</span>
  <span class="str">"retrievalConfig"</span><span class="pun">: </span><span class="pun">{</span>
    <span class="kwd">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/caching#RetrievalConfig">RetrievalConfig</a></code>)</span>
  <span class="pun">}</span><span class="pun">,</span>
  <span class="str">"includeServerSideToolInvocations"</span><span class="pun">: </span><span class="kwd">boolean</span>
<span class="pun">}</span></pre></devsite-code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="prototype" id="FunctionCallingConfig">
<h2 id="FunctionCallingConfig" data-text="FunctionCallingConfig" tabindex="-1">FunctionCallingConfig</h2>
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<section id="FunctionCallingConfig.description">
<p>Configuration for specifying function calling behavior.</p>
</section>
<section id="FunctionCallingConfig.FIELDS">
<thead>
<tr>
<th colspan="2">Fields</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<section id="FunctionCallingConfig.FIELDS.mode">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">mode</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">enum (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/caching#Mode">Mode</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. Specifies the mode in which function calling should execute. If unspecified, the default value will be set to AUTO.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="FunctionCallingConfig.FIELDS.allowed_function_names">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">allowedFunctionNames[]</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. A set of function names that, when provided, limits the functions the model will call.</p><p>This should only be set when the Mode is ANY or VALIDATED. Function names should match [FunctionDeclaration.name]. When set, model will predict a function call from only allowed function names.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<div class="second-column">
<section id="FunctionCallingConfig.SCHEMA_REPRESENTATION">
<table class="properties responsive fixed">
<thead>
<tr>
<th>JSON representation</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="margin:0;padding:0;"><div></div><devsite-code><pre style="border: 0;margin: 0;" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><span class="pun">{</span>
  <span class="str">"mode"</span><span class="pun">: </span><span class="kwd">enum (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/caching#Mode">Mode</a></code>)</span><span class="pun">,</span>
  <span class="str">"allowedFunctionNames"</span><span class="pun">: </span><span class="pun">[</span>
    <span class="kwd">string</span>
  <span class="pun">]</span>
<span class="pun">}</span></pre></devsite-code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="Mode">
<h2 id="Mode" data-text="Mode" tabindex="-1">Mode</h2>
<section id="Mode.description">
<p>Defines the execution behavior for function calling by defining the execution mode.</p>
</section>
<section id="Mode.ENUM_VALUES">
<table class="constants responsive fixed" id="Mode.ENUM_VALUES-table">
<colgroup>
<col width="25%"/>
<col/>
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th colspan="2">Enums</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr id="Mode.ENUM_VALUES.MODE_UNSPECIFIED">
<td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">MODE_UNSPECIFIED</code></td>
<td>Unspecified function calling mode. This value should not be used.</td>
</tr>
<tr id="Mode.ENUM_VALUES.AUTO">
<td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">AUTO</code></td>
<td>Default model behavior, model decides to predict either a function call or a natural language response.</td>
</tr>
<tr id="Mode.ENUM_VALUES.ANY">
<td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">ANY</code></td>
<td>Model is constrained to always predicting a function call only. If "allowedFunctionNames" are set, the predicted function call will be limited to any one of "allowedFunctionNames", else the predicted function call will be any one of the provided "functionDeclarations".</td>
</tr>
<tr id="Mode.ENUM_VALUES.NONE">
<td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">NONE</code></td>
<td>Model will not predict any function call. Model behavior is same as when not passing any function declarations.</td>
</tr>
<tr id="Mode.ENUM_VALUES.VALIDATED">
<td><code class="apitype" translate="no" dir="ltr">VALIDATED</code></td>
<td>Model decides to predict either a function call or a natural language response, but will validate function calls with constrained decoding. If "allowedFunctionNames" are set, the predicted function call will be limited to any one of "allowedFunctionNames", else the predicted function call will be any one of the provided "functionDeclarations".</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</section>
</section>
<section class="prototype" id="RetrievalConfig">
<h2 id="RetrievalConfig" data-text="RetrievalConfig" tabindex="-1">RetrievalConfig</h2>
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<section id="RetrievalConfig.description">
<p>Retrieval config.</p>
</section>
<section id="RetrievalConfig.FIELDS">
<thead>
<tr>
<th colspan="2">Fields</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<section id="RetrievalConfig.FIELDS.lat_lng">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">latLng</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/caching#LatLng">LatLng</a></code>)</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. The location of the user.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="RetrievalConfig.FIELDS.language_code">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">languageCode</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">string</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Optional. The language code of the user. Language code for content. Use language tags defined by <a href="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/bcp/bcp47.txt">BCP47</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<div class="second-column">
<section id="RetrievalConfig.SCHEMA_REPRESENTATION">
<table class="properties responsive fixed">
<thead>
<tr>
<th>JSON representation</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="margin:0;padding:0;"><div></div><devsite-code><pre style="border: 0;margin: 0;" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><span class="pun">{</span>
  <span class="str">"latLng"</span><span class="pun">: </span><span class="pun">{</span>
    <span class="kwd">object (<code translate="no" dir="ltr"><a href="/api/caching#LatLng">LatLng</a></code>)</span>
  <span class="pun">}</span><span class="pun">,</span>
  <span class="str">"languageCode"</span><span class="pun">: </span><span class="kwd">string</span>
<span class="pun">}</span></pre></devsite-code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="prototype" id="LatLng">
<h2 id="LatLng" data-text="LatLng" tabindex="-1">LatLng</h2>
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<section id="LatLng.description">
<p>An object that represents a latitude/longitude pair. This is expressed as a pair of doubles to represent degrees latitude and degrees longitude. Unless specified otherwise, this object must conform to the <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System#1984_version"> WGS84 standard</a>. Values must be within normalized ranges.</p>
</section>
<section id="LatLng.FIELDS">
<thead>
<tr>
<th colspan="2">Fields</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<section id="LatLng.FIELDS.latitude">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">latitude</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">number</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The latitude in degrees. It must be in the range [-90.0, +90.0].</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="LatLng.FIELDS.longitude">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">longitude</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">number</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>The longitude in degrees. It must be in the range [-180.0, +180.0].</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<div class="second-column">
<section id="LatLng.SCHEMA_REPRESENTATION">
<table class="properties responsive fixed">
<thead>
<tr>
<th>JSON representation</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td style="margin:0;padding:0;"><div></div><devsite-code><pre style="border: 0;margin: 0;" translate="no" dir="ltr" is-upgraded><span class="pun">{</span>
  <span class="str">"latitude"</span><span class="pun">: </span><span class="kwd">number</span><span class="pun">,</span>
  <span class="str">"longitude"</span><span class="pun">: </span><span class="kwd">number</span>
<span class="pun">}</span></pre></devsite-code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="prototype" id="UsageMetadata">
<h2 id="UsageMetadata" data-text="UsageMetadata" tabindex="-1">UsageMetadata</h2>
<div class="column-container">
<div class="reference">
<section id="UsageMetadata.description">
<p>Metadata on the usage of the cached content.</p>
</section>
<section id="UsageMetadata.FIELDS">
<thead>
<tr>
<th colspan="2">Fields</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<section id="UsageMetadata.FIELDS.total_token_count">
<div class="field-entry">
<div class="signature">
<span class="field-name">
<td><code translate="no" dir="ltr">totalTokenCount</code></td>
</span>
<span class="field-type">
<code translate="no" dir="ltr">integer</code>
</span>
</div>
<div class="field-description">
<p>Total number of tokens that the cached content consumes.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<div class="second-column">
<section id="UsageMetadata.SCHEMA_REPRESENTATION">
<table class="properties responsive fixed">

<span class="pun">}</span></pre></devsite-code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</section>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
